Recorded claim:
In the recorded Account Hub amendment, three widgets dropped persistent `this.l10n.connectRoot(this)` calls while keeping `translateFragment(this)` and a parent readiness wait. This was a change for those widgets, not a general rule against localization roots. Focused local tests passed, but the record left Linux CI confirmation open; inspect current widget behavior before reusing the approach.
